name: Marchirolo (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, the red charged with Saint Martin on horseback dividing his cloak (in white, red and yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Marchirolo, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Saint Martin on a white horse dividing his cloak
halo and cloak of the saint
